svg.title: The two standard MCP transports: stdio for local servers and Streamable HTTP for remote servers
svg.desc: Top: stdio. On your computer, the MCP client launches the server as a subprocess and they exchange newline-delimited JSON-RPC messages over standard input and output. Bottom: Streamable HTTP. The MCP client on your computer sends each message as an HTTP POST to one MCP endpoint on a server on the internet. The reply comes back as a JSON object or as a stream of events for that request. The messages are the same on both transports.
